protocol: 24 authored transfer questions. Keep related requests about the same occurrence and their restatements together. Whole task useful only with every supported demand evidenced for its span, no unrelated site, and all missing demands retained. Strict partial needs the right missing reason. Count false complete, evidence recall, end status, steps, live calls and median. Compare frozen shared/lexical/memory policies, quote heuristic, calibrated seed and updated policies and linear receipt updates with zero/seed/all experience. Selected policy fixed in implementation before writing these cases. Inspect unquoted tasks and shared receipt indices separately. Do not refit.
